description_sq:
Rruga Spiro Cipi, Allias, 300 metra nga shkolla Bajram Curri
Kati i 6 (i fundit) ne nje pallat egzistues pa ashensor
Orientimi juglindje
Siperfaqja neto 75m2 e ndare ne korridor shperndares, tualet me dritare+lavanderi+papafingo, dhome ndenjje+kuzhine, 2 dhoma gjumi 
E sapoinvestuar, e pabanuar me pare, me dokumentacion te rregullt
Kubature e rregullt, hapesira te medha me ndricim te bollshem
Ndodhet ne nje zone te qete me te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, prane shkollave, kopshteve dhe spitalit, 3 minuta nga stacioni i autobusit
Cmimi 110.000€
description_en: Spiro Cipi Street, Allias, 300 meters from Bajram Curri School 6th floor (top) in an existing building without elevator Orientation southeast Net area 75m2 divided into distribution corridor, bathroom with window+laundry+attic, living room+kitchen, 2 bedrooms Newly invested, never lived in before, with regular documentation Regular cubical, spaces large with plenty of light Located in a quiet area with all the necessary facilities, near schools, kindergartens and the hospital, 3 minutes from the bus station Price €110,000
